Description
The 1 gram PAMP Suisse Gold Bar – Lady Fortuna comes from one of the worlds leading gold refiners
PAMP Suisse
which is famous around the globe for its artistic design and excellent craftsmanship. PAMP Suisse Product has gone through extensive research and development to produce the highest quality gold bars. Their products are noted for their superior quality and authenticity.
The PAMP Suisse is devoted to providing the finest gold bullion bars with an aesthetically pleasing presentation for many years. 1 gram pamp gold that is produced is guaranteed authentic and in compliance with international and local standards and specifications. Gram Gold Bars have been able to continuously improve and implement new laboratory technology to continually ensure that its products are top quality.
The company’s many years of experience and research have resulted in the production of 1 gram PAMP Suisse Gold Bar – Lady Fortuna which is absolutely one of a kind. It is because of this that their bars are often sold out and go unsold for weeks at a time. The 1 Gram PAMP Suisse Fortuna Veriscan Gold Bar is one of the first in the world to embellish the appearance and design of a gold bar.
Pamp 1 Gram Gold Bar contains 1 gram(0.03215 oz) of fine gold. Whereas, it assists in gaining more security as it uses
Veriscan technology
which is unique to them to protect these gold bars. Every 1 gram gold bar is ensured its authenticity by using a microscopic topography to create a unique metallic fingerprint of sorts.
These small 1 gram PAMP Suisse gold bars are an excellent precious metal investment for new investors in the market.
Design of Pamp Suisse Gold Bar 1 Gram – Lady Fortuna
The PAMP Suisse Gold Bars are famous among investors due to their excellent design. The obverse of 1 Gram PAMP Suisse Fortuna Veriscan Gold Bar features the depiction of Lady Fortuna, who is considered as the Roman Goddess of fortune and luck. She’s blindfolded and holding an overflowing cornucopia in her arm. This depicts that good luck can turn into bad luck at any moment.
The reverse of the pamp suisse gold bar 1 gram features the depiction of the PAMP logo at the top of the design area, with the remaining markings arranged vertically down the bar’s face. The PAMP Logo incorporates the letters PAMP inscribed inside a little four-circle and the word Suisse engraved beneath. Other labels on the bar include the weight, purity, metal composition, and serial number. The serial numbers for this series are as follows: A one-letter, six-number code is used to identify the serial numbers in this series.

Contains 1 gram(0.03215 oz) of .9999 fine Gold.
Produced by the PAMP Sussie
Every gold bar accompanies its own assay card to guarantee its legitimacy.
Features the Veriscan Technology which uses metal’s microscopic topography to identify the product.
Eligible for Precious Metal IRAs.

Features the PAMP Suisse logo along with weight, purity, and the serial number on the reverse.
Each bar is assigned a unique serial number
